profiles.title: M4b proxy v1 · single capsule
profiles.description: One dynamic vertical capsule per player; 3D rotation and contacts are solver-resolved.

profiles.title: M4b proxy v2 · five-part rigid compound
profiles.description: Five fixed capsules/spheres form one freely rotating rigid player body; no articulated joints.

scenarioCatalog.title: Two defenders, opposing angles, open field
Four defenders against runner and blockers
First hit followed by second and third defenders
One grip releases while a second remains
One defender initiates, another completes takedown
Quarterback releases before sack is complete
Loose ball, two opposing recovery attempts
Recovery attempt while another defender makes contact
Eight-player pile, ball can escape and stay live
Eight-player scrum, loose ball escapes into open field
QB sneak with line drive and two teammates behind
